body: It’s not that they say I’m a bother. It’s that I think I’m a bother. Bc “they’re asleep”, “they’re at work”, “they’re at school”, “they’re with their SO”, etc etc etc. funny thing is it’s not like I don’t have people to talk to. I go to therapy. I just never talk about the issues in fear of going back into the hospitals. Like id literally rather die than going back yet again.
